Antarctic visitor incoming ❄️

While it's not literal penguins visiting us from the Antarctic ice edge, it does demark the trajectory of some air heading our way.

This very cold air brings the potential for snow to around sea level for parts of Southland, Otago and Canterbury Tuesday morning.

Much of Te Ika-a-Māui is chillier than Te Waipounamu this morning, with Galatea (Bay of Plenty) shivering at -3.3°C while Timaru sweats at 15°C 🔀

Westerly winds whipping up warmth in the south turn strong southerly during today, bringing back the brrrrr in tomorrow's brisk minimum temperatures ☃️
